description:
Cast Mindslaver by paying {6}.
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to control target opponent during their next turn.
Move to the opponent's turn who you targeted using Mindslaver.
Activate Tasigur by paying {2}{G/U}{G/U}, causing you to mill two cards and then choose the opponent you are in control of, allowing you to choose to return Mindslaver from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
